entries.text: Results Explorer read model 20 carries a hardware class for every result (a pinned CPU class table, T0 to T5, plus managed and unclassified), the managed service size, and the known-defect reason, and the BenchBox version (recorded, or inferred from the run date).

A managed-service result no longer records the client's CPU at the top level of its environment (it stays under environment.client_host), and a container can name its host CPU with BENCHBOX_CONTAINER_HOST_CPU_MODEL.
